# Main-table baseline evaluation

`run_vanilla_metrics.sh` scores the already generated BF16 vanilla EditMGT
predictions for MagicBrush test, Inter-Edit test/en, and PIE-Bench v1. The
predictions were generated by the repository's native EditMGT benchmark entry
points (36 steps, CFG 6, mask-free, no KV cache). This wrapper adds no new
inference code and uses the same metric implementations as the Ours rows.

Run from the repository root:

```bash
GPU_IDS=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 NUM_GPUS=8 \
  bash third_party/table_completion/run_vanilla_metrics.sh
```

Results are written beside the predictions under
`outputs/dimo_step4000_sft8000_comparison/vanilla36/`. Check each
`metrics/summary.json` for `complete=true` before copying its means to the
tables. PIE-Bench and Inter-Edit quality metrics use masks for scoring, even
though the vanilla editor did not receive a mask during inference. Inter-Edit
has 3,413 selected English samples; 2 have empty masks, so 3,411 are scored.

Run `python third_party/table_completion/validate_tables.py` to check row
widths and compare the local EditMGT cells with the raw summary JSON. The
source audit and explanation for unavailable `N/R` cells are in
[`provenance.md`](provenance.md). `mark_unreported.py` was used only to replace
literal empty-cell placeholders with explicit `N/R`; it does not generate
benchmark scores.

## Real-time model runs

`run_baseline.py` reads the exact local EditMGT selections, generates one
prediction per selected sample, records CUDA-synchronized pipeline time, and
keeps MagicBrush turns on the same GPU. `run_model.sh` launches one process
per GPU and then calls the repository's existing metric scorers. Model
adapters and compatibility changes live under `third_party/`.

```bash
RUN_TAG=corrected GPU_IDS=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 bash third_party/table_completion/run_model.sh chordedit
python third_party/table_completion/update_realtime_tables.py
python third_party/table_completion/validate_tables.py
```

Use `RUN_TAG=name` to write a fresh run to
`outputs/real_time_baselines/MODEL_name/`, and use `--limit` with
`run_baseline.py` for a separate smoke run. Copy values to the tables only
after every selected prediction is present and `metrics/summary.json` says
`complete=true`. Model versions, prompts and image preparation are recorded
in [`provenance.md`](provenance.md).
